g.text: - Forge discovers the @Mod entry point and hosts registries, events, config, and networking
- Forgotten Cantrips registers content, event hooks, config, and Mana and Artifice cantrip callbacks
- Mana and Artifice invokes cantrip callbacks; feature logic changes Minecraft world state server-side
- Client-side mod code uses screens, renderers, and resource assets
- Runtime state lives in world saves, entity/block state, player NBT/capabilities, and config files
